notes:
Overview:
- Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Building an in-app analyst assistant + search/rerank for product insights.
- Completed 3-week Hosted API trial; now evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.

Trial summary (hosted API):
- POC period: 2026-02-16 -> 2026-03-08.
- Traffic simulated with real user prompts from beta: avg requests/day ~ 42k, peak hourly ~6.4k requests.
- Observed QPS: baseline 6-9 QPS; peak bursts up to ~26 QPS (short spikes, 1-3 minutes).
- Avg token mix: prompt ~120 tokens, completion ~110 tokens, combined ~230 tokens/request (varies by persona).
- 95th pct latency on hosted: ~430ms for 230 tokens; 50th pct ~180ms.
- Quality: acceptable for assistant flows; reranking uses embeddings+rerank pipeline (embeddings measured separately).

Customer constraints & priorities:
- Primary: 95th pct latency <= 350-400ms for assistant interactions.
- Cost-sensitive: target gross inference spend reduction of 30-45% vs Hosted as traffic grows.
- Compliance: must run within customer VPC (no public egress), SOC2 required, SSO via SAML + audit logging + KMS for key control.
- Preference for model variants with quantized profiles to reduce unit cost; open to Redwood recommendations.

Dedicated sizing / traffic forecast (recommended):
- Baseline forecast (next 6 months): expected growth x3 in MAU after GA; projected sustained QPS 18 (moving average), peak burst QPS 36 (safety factor 2x).
- Token mix forecast: weighted avg tokens/request ~260 after adding longer system prompts and richer context caches.
- Concurrency estimate: average concurrent requests ~40, peak concurrency ~90 during spikes.
- Dedicated pool recommendation: start with 3 GPU-capacity nodes (A100-equivalent throughput baseline) with autoscale up to 6 for burst. Plan for 2x redundancy for upgrades/maintenance.
- Cache & batching: enable prefix/KV cache to reduce effective token compute by ~12-18% for assistant flows; configure batching for low-latency small requests.
- Fallbacks: configure routing policy to fallback to smaller model variants for non-critical rerank jobs to save cost.

POC milestones & recent activity:
- 2026-02-18: kickoff call + Fireflies ff-2026-02-18-7591. Delivered sample request traces.
- 2026-02-25: internal perf run with 10k synthetic users; observed QPS peeks ~28.
- 2026-03-05: follow-up demo; security questionnaire submitted (drive link). Fireflies ff-2026-03-05-8310.
- 2026-03-10: SE deep-dive (Maya) on batching & KV cache config; drafted Dedicated sizing (attached).

Commercial & procurement notes:
- Procurement timeline: 4-8 weeks after proposal (legal + security review).
- Pricing sensitivity: customer wants tiered committed-rate model (sustained baseline + burst pricing) — prefer month-to-month commit with option to convert to 12-month reserved.
- Estimated ARR range discussed: $150k-$350k (depending on commit & support SLAs).
- Competitor watch: evaluating Anthropic for quality; OpenAI for pricing on small/medium workloads.

Quotes / paraphrases:
- CTO: "Latency is the gating factor for our assistant adoption — anything over ~400ms feels sluggish in product."
- Head of Infra: "We need private VPC peering and signed BAAs; cannot have uncontrolled egress."

Open items / next steps:
- Finalize Dedicated sizing doc and demo of autoscale behavior under 2x peak load (action: SE + infra, due 2026-03-20).
- Legal to review SOC2/KMS language (action: AE to coordinate, due 2026-03-28).
- Prepare committed pricing tier options (baseline 3-node vs 6-node burst) and present slides for exec review (due 2026-04-02).
